source:
@@U03973@@
rock upon rock and mountain following mountain,
then hills that gently slope down to valleys
where everything is green and full of growth.
Nature has enough to rejoice in
without your wild upheavals.

@@U03975@@
That’s what you say!
To you it’s all so clear.
But one who was there knows differently.
And I was there.
I was there when the infernal abyss still seethed and
welled up into rivers shooting flames;
when Moloch, with his hammer,
welded rock to rock,
scattering mountain fragments far and wide.
The land is still littered with great masses of stone.
Who can explain the force that hurled them there?
Philosophers?
How, when they don’t understand?
“Let them lie there,” they say.
“We've made fools enough of ourselves
racking our brains.”
It’s only the common people in their simple dignity
who have understood, and their belief in
ancient wisdom is not to be shaken.
To them it’s a miracle,
and Satan gets his credit!
This is the crutch of faith that lets them hobble
straight to Devil’s Rock and Devil’s Bridge.

@@U03977@@
I must admit,
a Devil’s-eye view of Nature
is not uninteresting.

@@U03979@@
I couldn’ care less!
Let Nature do as Nature does!
BAWSH, PARE wor 397
translation:
@@U03973@@
岩石连岩石，山连山，
然后是缓缓倾斜到山谷的山丘
那里一切都是绿色的，充满了生长。
大自然有足够的欢乐
没有你的剧烈动荡。

@@U03975@@
这就是你说的！
对你来说，一切都是那么清楚。
但在场的人却有不同的认识。
我也在场。
当地狱深渊还沸腾时我就在那里
涌入河流并喷出火焰；
当莫洛克用他的锤子，
将岩石与岩石焊接在一起，
山体碎片四溅四散。
这片土地上仍然散布着大量的石头。
谁能解释一下是什么力量把他们扔到那里的？
哲学家？
当他们不明白时怎么办？
“让他们躺在那里，”他们说。
“我们已经让自己受够了愚弄
绞尽脑汁。”
这只是普通人的简单尊严
谁已经理解并相信
古老的智慧是不可动摇的。
对他们来说这是一个奇迹，
撒但得到了他的功劳！
这就是信仰的拐杖，让他们步履蹒跚
直接前往魔鬼岩和魔鬼桥。

@@U03977@@
我必须承认，
魔鬼之眼的自然观
并非无趣。

@@U03979@@
我一点也不在乎！
让自然做自然吧！
BAWSH、PARE 世界 397
